scope: Developer diagnosis of this exact rejected candidate; no optimized implementation supplied.
observed: CUDA capture of the unchanged parent changes the actual attention path. In this installed Transformers, is_tracing includes stream capture; _ignore_causal_mask_sdpa then produces a mask and use_gqa_in_sdpa expands KV heads. First attention eager: K=[1,8,256,128], mask=None, GQA true, causal true. Capture: K=[1,32,256,128], bool mask, GQA false, causal false. Upstream Q/K/V agree. First attention difference 0.0009765625; full generation maxabs 5.0625. Original greedy tokens agree but logits fail the frozen tolerance.
intervention: A diagnostic limited to the known unpadded full prefill preserved the eager attention decision during capture; Graph still executed and two complete generations had zero error. This does not justify globally disabling masks or assuming padded inputs have the same semantics.
